encounter.title: COMBAT-001 debug — Shield (seed 15)
encounter.notes: COMBAT-001 spike/experiment, NOT accepted design, separate from prologue/Act I content. Same easy 6x7 seed 15 board as rock-spike.json (11 arrows, N4 E1 S4 W2; initially free N2 E1 S1 W1). One enemy on N (shieldbearer, 4 hp, ATTACK IN 5 dmg 1 -- gentle, damage is not the point of this spike) with Shield: SHIELD IN 3. Demonstrates: at world turn 3 the ability fires and raises a one-shot shield; the next projectile hit on the shieldbearer is absorbed (no HP damage, no interrupt) and drops the shield; the following hit damages normally. No Rotate in this debug encounter.
